name: QuantumDiamonds
description: QuantumDiamonds develops diamond-based quantum sensors using nitrogen-vacancy centers for non-destructive inspection of semiconductor chips. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich, the company's systems detect magnetic fields to localize defects at micrometer scale, with proof-of-concept work completed with nine of the world's ten largest chip manufacturers.

products.name: Diamond Quantum Sensor System
products.description: NV-center diamond-based quantum sensing platform for non-destructive magnetic field imaging and semiconductor chip defect localization

highlights: Completed proof-of-concept work with nine of the world's ten largest chip manufacturers

Spun out of the Technical University of Munich with breakthrough NV-center sensing technology

news.title: QuantumDiamonds Deploys QDm.1 Failure Analysis System at Taiwan's iST Semiconductor Test House
news.excerpt: QuantumDiamonds installed its QDm.1 quantum diamond microscopy system at Integrated Service Technology (iST) in Hsinchu, Taiwan, marking the company's first operational installation in Asia. The system provides non-destructive 3D current-path imaging for advanced chip packages including 2.5D and 3D stacked architectures.
